_contract: Recorded per-service exceptions to the symbol-fork ratchet (#18688). An entry says: this symbol is bound at `canonical` and at each of `sites` (path:qualname, exact), for `reason`, tracked by `issue`. A cluster whose every binding is the canonical site or a recorded site is not a fork; ANY other binding of the name still counts. Shrink-only: an entry missing a reason or issue is rejected, and a recorded site that no longer exists is reported stale. See docs/developer/RATCHET_BASELINES.md.

exceptions.reason: SLM binding: separate service with its own auth stack. user_management binding: delegating wrapper kept as a distinct dependency_overrides key.
